findings.rootCause: PackedLogicalRuleProgram.addScalarDependencies treated an EXISTS/IN/ANY/ALL subquery's dependency set as addRelationOutputs(body) (names the body can BIND) instead of the names it REFERENCES, and ignored the referenced-name set the codec already records in the scalar's semanticScope slot. Planner-derived EXISTS (existsScalar(int)) recorded no referenced set at all and the codec recorded none for IN/COMPARE_ANY/COMPARE_ALL. Consumers pruneUnusedOptionals (DISTINCT/REDUCED/GROUP observers) and addProjectionBelowOrderAlternative therefore dropped an OPTIONAL binding that only the subquery's inner FILTER reads.
findings.change: (1) New shared PLRP analysis relationReferencedNames/addRelationReferencedNames (structural over-approximation of every binding symbol a packed relation references, with a completeness flag for SERVICE/UNSUPPORTED; roadmap 4.1 'referenced'). (2) addScalarDependencies uses the codec's semanticScope name set when present, else the structural set (SUBQUERY_VALUE guard kept). (3) existsScalar(int) records nameSetPayload(relationReferencedNames(body)) so derived EXISTS carry full masks (PackedBindingFacts scheduling). (4) Precision guard: projection-below-ORDER masks the ORDER dependencies by the ORDER input's outputs so EXISTS-local names do not block the push. (5) PackedQueryCodec.compareSubqueryScalar records VarNameCollector names for IN/ANY/ALL; PackedBindingFacts reads the slot for all four operators. Over-approximating dependencies can only keep more OPTIONALs / decline more pushes, never introduce a wrong plan. findings.rootCause: PackedLogicalRuleProgram.addCorrelatedMinusAlternative guarded the MINUS -> FILTER(NOT EXISTS) rewrite (and the typed SEMI_ANTI_MINUS_ASSURED_SHARED anti-joins + SEMANTIC_ASSURED_SHARED_MINUS_FILTER hint) only on shared = outputs(L) ∩ outputs(R) being assured on both sides plus an operator allow-list. Nothing checked names the body merely REFERENCES: for `?x :p ?n MINUS { ?x :q ?m FILTER(?n = ?m) }` ?n (left-only, read by the inner FILTER) or a nested MINUS right side reading ?n were invisible. At execution FilterIterator.evaluateSubstitutedExists substitutes EVERY bound name of the incoming row (BindingAssignerOptimizer), so the probe got NOT EXISTS semantics while MINUS never lets ?n reach the body; the derived EXISTS also recorded only the shared names. The FILTER alternative is not protected by the Join's Difference-only binding-push guard, so an enclosing join can also hand outer-scope bindings to it (critique).
findings.change: New guard substitutionEquivalentMinusBody, evaluated after the existing P1 checks and before ANY of the three emissions (FILTER alternative, typed anti-joins, semantic flag): P2 widened per the critique — referenced(R) ∩ (outputs(L) ∪ names occurring anywhere in the query outside R) ⊆ shared, using relationReferencedNames (3.2.2) plus a new root walk addNamesOutsideMinusBody (the codec now passes the root relation to the rule program via setRootExpression; unknown root or incomplete referenced set => decline, fail-safe); P4 conservative — no PROJECTION/MULTI_PROJECTION anywhere in R (including nested EXISTS/IN/ANY/ALL bodies); P5 — no EXTENSION or GROUP element in R targets a shared name. P3 (nested DIFFERENCE/INTERSECTION right side referencing a shared name) was DROPPED per the critique: the differential test minusWithNestedMinusOnSharedVariableOnlyStaysRewritableAndCorrect (anti-join forced by cost) proves the substituted variable keeps its name and comparison domain (green before and after; PackedCorrelatedMinusAlternativeTest#typedSemiAntiAlternativesSupportComposedLocalRightHandSides therefore keeps its Difference RHS case). The derived EXISTS now records nameSetPayload(referenced(R)) (full set) while the anti-join correlation key stays the shared names; addSemiAntiAlternatives computes correlatedNames = outputs(L) ∩ referenced(R) (cost-only; the executor recomputes keys from the body). Planner half of 3.4.4: the minus-assured-shared hint is emitted exactly for bodies passing P1+P2(widened)+P4+P5 and safeCorrelatedMinusProbe, and propagates only to the FILTER_COMMUTATION copies of that same FILTER (same input/body), which the new hint-scan test re-checks against P2.
